run.verify: Verify this is correct before starting.
run.checkPosition: 1. Check the tool is positioned correctly (pictured).
run.checkCircuit3D: 2. Gently push the probe needle to check the circuit is triggered properly (indicated by a green light).
run.checkCircuitPlate: 2. Lift your touch plate to the tool to check the circuit is good (indicated by a green light), then put it back where it was.
run.holdPlate: 3. In some cases, holding the touch plate still while probing will give a more consistent measurement.
